description: Main application entry point for a Flutter-based Notes app. Defines app initialization, theming, routing, main pages, and UI components such as note list and note cards.

classes.name: NotesApp
classes.description: Root widget of the Notes application setting up theme, routes, and initial home page.

classes.name: NotesHomePage
classes.description: Stateful widget representing the main page displaying list of notes with search, grid/list toggle, and theme toggle.

classes.name: NoteCard
classes.description: Stateless widget representing a UI card for displaying individual note summaries with options to edit, delete, and view details.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Application entry point initializing Flutter bindings, environment, and running the app.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Build method of NotesApp, setting up MaterialApp with themes, routes, and home widget.

methods.name: initState
methods.description: Initializes the NotesHomePage state, loads notes on startup.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Build method of NotesHomePage, constructing UI with AppBar, search, notes list, and FAB.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Build method of NoteCard, rendering note data and actions.
